_about: Generation plan for the 32 records of CH01-LOCATION-IMAGE-REGISTER-V10. Each record lists its reference images in attachment order (Image 1, Image 2, ...). 'master:<key>' is an approved master from Ref/; 'plate:<ID>' is this run's approved plate of another record, so that record must be approved first. A record's wave is one more than the highest wave it depends on: wave 1 needs only the masters, wave 2 needs approved wave-1 plates, wave 3 needs wave-2 plates. mode 'derive' = a new camera built from the references; mode 'state-edit' = the same camera as Image 1 with only the stated state changed (the register gives these pairs identical camera text). 'role' is guidance for the prompt writer, not prompt text. 'quality' is high for every record unless the record sets its own: xhigh only where dense exact inscriptions or exact counts make it genuinely hard. max is never used without the user's approval.
